name: LFDA
note: local Fisher discriminant analysis (Sugiyama 2007): LDA that keeps local structure, closed form by a generalised eigenproblem

name: MLKR
note: metric learning for kernel regression (Weinberger and Tesauro 2007): a linear map minimising leave-one-out Nadaraya-Watson error; the regression sibling of NCA and the same shape as `ncaProblem`

name: RCA
note: relevant component analysis: whitens by the within-chunklet covariance; two lines of linear algebra

name: LSML_Supervised
note: least squares metric learning from quadruplets (Liu et al. 2012): closed form plus a projected step onto the PSD cone

name: ITML_Supervised
note: information-theoretic metric learning (Davis et al. 2007): the Mahalanobis matrix closest in LogDet divergence to a prior that satisfies pair constraints; the textbook constraint-based learner, solved by Bregman projections (a traced loop over constraints)

name: SDML_Supervised
note: sparse determinant metric learning (Qi et al. 2009): a graphical-lasso penalty on the metric learnt from similar pairs

name: MMC_Supervised
note: Xing et al. 2002 (the first Mahalanobis learner, pairs and a convex program); only the name `MMC` matched, and that is a different omai export

name: SCML_Supervised
note: sparse compositional metric learning (Shi et al. 2014): a sparse combination of rank-one bases, learnt with triplets

name: Covariance
note: the inverse covariance as the metric: the pieces are there, no transformer wrapper

name: ITML
